name: Veridical Viento
source:
The Elemental Memoria are a quartet of Magical Girls empowered by the four elements that create the world and imbue everything with life...Fire, Water, Earth, and Wind... Together, they have been able to do everything together and, without much effort, they've beaten their final opponent, the malicious Kikirin who distorted death and life... And although they managed to save the world, they quickly come to realize they no longer have a reason to be Magical Girls with no evil to defeat... Fearing that their memories of being Magical Girls will be wiped away by the familiar that granted them their powers, they try to find a way to preserve them before it's too late...

However, Viento Memoria, the servant of the wind, wonders if these memories really are worth keeping... Always having felt like the most inferior of the four, she has yet to really feel as if she's ever truly made use of her full potential as a Magical Girl... Feeling distant from the other 3 Memoria, she doubts that they were never truly as connected together as they liked to believe, and that it'd be best to forget everything if it means also forgetting these doubts... Tiera Memoria, the upholder of the earth, has other plans... Wishing to spend their last days as magical girls together in a closed off summer house on an island, she is determined to find a way for them to keep their powers to themselves... 

Though Viento Memoria thought her passion for Magical Girls had gradually died over time, upon seeing the sparkle of determination Tiera Memoria's eyes, she wonders if she'll be born again and truly feel the magic of the wind guide her... For it's in the eyes of the earth that she feels most reminded of what initially made her love magical girls so much...
